BOOKKEEPING &
FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
SERVICES PROPOSAL

P R O P O S E D  B Y

GOOD FOOT SUPPORT SERVICES

APRIL 2026

1. CONTEXT & OBJECTIVES
Good Foot Support Services is a growing, multi-program
organization with an annual operating budget of approximately
$1.1M, supported by government funding (ESDC), private
foundations, and earned revenue.
The organization has strong foundational systems in place (QBO,
Dext, Plooto, Dayforce), and clean financial records. However, some
challenges remain around:
Manual, time-intensive funder reporting (especially ESDC)
Payroll allocation complexity across programs
Inconsistent internal workflows (expense claims, approvals)
Limited automation between accounting and reporting outputs
This engagement is designed to:
Fully manage and operate the day-to-day bookkeeping function,
ensuring accuracy, consistency, and audit readiness
Provide ongoing financial management and strategic leadership
to support the Executive Director and Board
Following an initial stabilization period (first 2–3 months), we can
identify and implement targeted process and systems
improvements to reduce manual effort and improve reporting
accuracy. These may include:
Simplifying payroll allocation across programs and funders
(including potential payroll software changes)
Optimizing class and project structures within QBO
Enabling more automated, system-driven funder reporting
outputs

2. SCOPE - BOOKKEEPING & PAYROLL
A. Full-Service Bookkeeping
Sympl will take full ownership of day-to-day bookkeeping
operations:
Process all transactions in QuickBooks Online:
Revenue (grants, donations, delivery income)
Expenses (vendors, payroll entries, credit cards)
Manage:
Accounts Payable (via Plooto)
Accounts Receivable
Bank and credit card reconciliations
Maintain:
Deferred revenue schedule
Program / grant-level tracking (classes in QBO)
Ensure all entries are:
Accurate
Properly coded
Fully documented and audit-ready
B. Payroll Management 
Manage bi-weekly payroll oversight (5–6 FT, ~30 PT staff)
including:
Dayforce (time tracking)
PowerPay (processing)
QBO (accounting)
Process and reconcile payroll entries each cycle
Ensure CRA compliance (CPP, EI, tax remittances)
Prepare:
T4, T4A, ROE
WSIB (as applicable)
Budget: $2,300/month ($1,500 bookkeeping | $ 800 payroll)

3. SCOPE - FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
A. Reporting & Board Support
Monthly & Board reporting package:
P&L (program-level where applicable)
Balance Sheet
Cash Flow
AR/AP Aging
Budget vs. actual reports
Prepare financial inputs for:
ESDC quarterly reporting
Private funders (~5 major funders)
B. Compliance, Audit & Year-End
Manage:
HST filings and PSB rebates
Payroll remittances
T3010 Registered Charity Return
Lead audit preparation:
Working papers
Schedules
Auditor liaison
Support ESDC monitoring audit
C. Fractional Financial Management: 
Lead annual budgeting process
Develop rolling forecasts
Monitor cash flow
Provide strategic financial guidance, scenario analysis, and ad
hoc insights
Weekly check-ins with Executive Director
Budget: $2,500/month

4. SCOPE - PROCESS IMPROVEMENT & 
DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION 
Following onboarding and stabilization, we can support targeted
improvements across the following areas:
Scope of work may include:
Financial Systems Optimization: Review and refine use of
QBO, Dext, Plooto, and payroll systems to ensure alignment and
efficiency
Chart of Accounts & Class Structure Enhancement: Optimize
program and funder tracking within QBO to support cleaner,
more automated reporting
Funder Reporting Automation: Reduce manual Excel-based
reporting by aligning accounting outputs with ESDC and
foundation requirements
Payroll Allocation & System Optimization: Simplify and
standardize payroll allocation across programs and funding
sources, including a review of the current payroll setup
(Dayforce/PowerPay) and assessment of alternative systems
where appropriate to better support integration, reporting, and
operational efficiency
Expense & Approval Workflows: Streamline employee expense
submissions, approvals, and documentation processes
Reporting & Dashboard Development: Build standardized
templates and dashboards for leadership, Board, and funders
Process Documentation & SOPs: Document key finance
processes to improve consistency, clarity, and onboarding
Budget: $6,000-$25,000 (one-time fee, based on final scope)

SUMMARY OF FEES
Service Module Duration Cost (CAD)
Bookkeeping & Payroll Ongoing $2,300 (monthly)
Financial Management Ongoing $2,500 (monthly)
One-time Setup & Transition
Onboarding and transition of bookkeeping &
financial management
Process documentation and workflow setup
Payroll allocation and funder reporting
template review/build
4 weeks $3,000 (one time)
Total Ongoing Monthly Cost: $4,800 / month
Note: Above costs do not include software subscription fees

WHY US?
Sympl Solutions is committed to ensuring a high standard of financial
clarity and timely support. We bring:
A responsive, detail-oriented team
Decade-long expertise in nonprofit finance
Streamlined tech integration and clear process flows
BIPOC and immigrant-led leadership with lived experiences in
community, social service and arts & culture
We value thoughtful system design, clarity in reporting, and
building long-term trusted partnerships
Any new requirements or adjustments can be discussed and
integrated as needed. We work with transparency, flexibility, and a
commitment to helping our partners thrive.
proposal.cleaned_text:
BOOKKEEPING & FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT SERVICES PROPOSAL

PROPOSED BY

GOOD FOOT SUPPORT SERVICES

APRIL 2026

1. CONTEXT & OBJECTIVES
Good Foot Support Services is a growing, multi-program organization with an annual operating budget of approximately $1.1M, supported by government funding (ESDC), private foundations, and earned revenue.
The organization has strong foundational systems in place (QBO, Dext, Plooto, Dayforce), and clean financial records. However, some challenges remain around:
• Manual, time-intensive funder reporting (especially ESDC)
• Payroll allocation complexity across programs
• Inconsistent internal workflows (expense claims, approvals)
• Limited automation between accounting and reporting outputs

This engagement is designed to:
• Fully manage and operate the day-to-day bookkeeping function, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and audit readiness
• Provide ongoing financial management and strategic leadership to support the Executive Director and Board

Following an initial stabilization period (first 2–3 months), we can identify and implement targeted process and systems improvements to reduce manual effort and improve reporting accuracy. These may include:
• Simplifying payroll allocation across programs and funders (including potential payroll software changes)
• Optimizing class and project structures within QBO
• Enabling more automated, system-driven funder reporting outputs

2. SCOPE - BOOKKEEPING & PAYROLL
A. Full-Service Bookkeeping
Sympl will take full ownership of day-to-day bookkeeping operations:
• Process all transactions in QuickBooks Online:
  - Revenue (grants, donations, delivery income)
  - Expenses (vendors, payroll entries, credit cards)
• Manage:
  - Accounts Payable (via Plooto)
  - Accounts Receivable
  - Bank and credit card reconciliations
• Maintain:
  - Deferred revenue schedule
  - Program / grant-level tracking (classes in QBO)
• Ensure all entries are:
  - Accurate
  - Properly coded
  - Fully documented and audit-ready

B. Payroll Management
Manage bi-weekly payroll oversight (5–6 FT, ~30 PT staff) including:
• Dayforce (time tracking)
• PowerPay (processing)
• QBO (accounting)
• Process and reconcile payroll entries each cycle
• Ensure CRA compliance (CPP, EI, tax remittances)
• Prepare:
  - T4, T4A, ROE
  - WSIB (as applicable)
Budget: $2,300/month ($1,500 bookkeeping | $800 payroll)

3. SCOPE - FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
A. Reporting & Board Support
Monthly & Board reporting package:
• P&L (program-level where applicable)
• Balance Sheet
• Cash Flow
• AR/AP Aging
• Budget vs. actual reports
Prepare financial inputs for:
• ESDC quarterly reporting
• Private funders (~5 major funders)

B. Compliance, Audit & Year-End
Manage:
• HST filings and PSB rebates
• Payroll remittances
• T3010 Registered Charity Return
Lead audit preparation:
• Working papers
• Schedules
• Auditor liaison
• Support ESDC monitoring audit

C. Fractional Financial Management:
• Lead annual budgeting process
• Develop rolling forecasts
• Monitor cash flow
• Provide strategic financial guidance, scenario analysis, and ad hoc insights
• Weekly check-ins with Executive Director
Budget: $2,500/month

4. SCOPE - PROCESS IMPROVEMENT & DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION
Following onboarding and stabilization, we can support targeted improvements across the following areas:
Scope of work may include:
• Financial Systems Optimization: Review and refine use of QBO, Dext, Plooto, and payroll systems to ensure alignment and efficiency
• Chart of Accounts & Class Structure Enhancement: Optimize program and funder tracking within QBO to support cleaner, more automated reporting
• Funder Reporting Automation: Reduce manual Excel-based reporting by aligning accounting outputs with ESDC and foundation requirements
• Payroll Allocation & System Optimization: Simplify and standardize payroll allocation across programs and funding sources, including a review of the current payroll setup (Dayforce/PowerPay) and assessment of alternative systems where appropriate to better support integration, reporting, and operational efficiency
• Expense & Approval Workflows: Streamline employee expense submissions, approvals, and documentation processes
• Reporting & Dashboard Development: Build standardized templates and dashboards for leadership, Board, and funders
• Process Documentation & SOPs: Document key finance processes to improve consistency, clarity, and onboarding
Budget: $6,000–$25,000 (one-time fee, based on final scope)

SUMMARY OF FEES
Service Module | Duration | Cost (CAD)
• Bookkeeping & Payroll | Ongoing | $2,300 (monthly)
• Financial Management | Ongoing | $2,500 (monthly)
• One-time Setup & Transition:
  - Onboarding and transition of bookkeeping & financial management
  - Process documentation and workflow setup
  - Payroll allocation and funder reporting template review/build
  Duration: 4 weeks | Cost: $3,000 (one time)
Total Ongoing Monthly Cost: $4,800 / month
Note: Above costs do not include software subscription fees

WHY US?
Sympl Solutions is committed to ensuring a high standard of financial clarity and timely support. We bring:
• A responsive, detail-oriented team
• Decade-long expertise in nonprofit finance
• Streamlined tech integration and clear process flows
• BIPOC and immigrant-led leadership with lived experiences in community, social service and arts & culture
We value thoughtful system design, clarity in reporting, and building long-term trusted partnerships.
Any new requirements or adjustments can be discussed and integrated as needed. We work with transparency, flexibility, and a commitment to helping our partners thrive.

WHY US?
Sympl Solutions is committed to ensuring a high standard of financial
clarity and timely support. We bring:
A responsive, detail-oriented team
Decade-long expertise in nonprofit finance

community, social service and arts & culture
We value thoughtful system design, clarity in reporting, and
building long-term trusted partnerships
Any new requirements or adjustments can be discussed and
integrated as needed. We work with transparency, flexibility, and a
commitment to helping our partners thrive.
